liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Turn On Your Lovelight** (3 reviews, 1 other source): Lovelight contains long improvisations that help make the show a classic; Pigpen's rap during Lovelight is a standout [1][8][10][16]
- **Good Lovin'** (3 reviews): The Good Lovin', drums, Good Lovin' sequence is very long and intense; Pigpen delivers a long rap during Good Lovin' [8][9][12]
- **Loser** (1 review): Loser is singled out as a classic 1971 version [10]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Sugar Magnolia is called excellent [12]
- **I'm A King Bee** (1 review): Pigpen plays fine harmonica while Jerry encourages him and fills the gaps in his phrasing [11]

## The recordings

- **gd1971-04-17.mtx.tobin.107384.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 178 min; rated 3.86/5 by 7 [1]
- **gd1971-04-17.sbd.sirmick.88760.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 150 min; rated 4.71/5 by 7 [4]. Said about its sound: Possible splice in Mama Tried joins two sources; the first part has noticeably more hiss; Good Lovin' part 1 fades in, and Lovelight has a cut near 12:16 with little missing [4]
- **gd71-04-17.sbd.nayfield.121.122.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 154 min; rated 4.52/5 by 25 [7]. Said about its sound: Sound on King Bee is described as flawless; Soundboard has good presence but sounds dry and lifeless, with vocals mixed too high [11][12]
- **gd1971-04-17.dts.mtx.tobin.107385.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 178 min [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer recalls Bob Weir saying this show is a prime example of Pigpen at his best [8]
- Before the show, Princeton officials hassled Jerry for smoking outside; he reportedly vowed the band would never play there again [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1971-04-17.mtx.tobin.107384.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Matrix 2 Source Mix - SBD (shn id 89031) soundboard lineage : MSR> R1? > R2 MAXELL UD35-90 3.75 IPS (Dick Latvala) Technics RS-1506 > R3 TANDBERG TD20A 7.5IPS… [1]
- **gd1971-04-17.sbd.sirmick.88760.flac16**: source: MSR> R1? > R2 MAXELL UD35-90 3.75 IPS (Dick Latvala) Technics RS-1506 > R3 TANDBERG TD20A 7.5IPS [4]. Also: Right channel gain lowered 2 dB, dropouts repaired, clicks removed, then downsampled with Voxengo R8brain and dithered [4]
- **gd71-04-17.sbd.nayfield.121.122.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Rod Nayfield; source: Soundboard [7]
- **gd1971-04-17.dts.mtx.tobin.107385.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: DTS Audio Matrix Mix. SBD (shn id 89031) soundboard lineage : MSR> R1? > R2 MAXELL UD35-90 3.75 IPS (Dick Latvala) Technics RS-1506 > R3 TANDBERG TD20A 7.5IPS… [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by lostlivedead.blogspot.com: [April 17, 1971, Dillon Gym, Princeton University, Princeton, NJ](https://lostlivedead.blogspot.com/2014/03/april-17-1971-dillon-gym-princeton.html) [21]
- Fan art by Justin Gage: [Dead Notes #1 :: Good Lovin’ (4/17/71 Dillon Gym / Princeton) - Aquarium Drunkard](https://aquariumdrunkard.com/2013/05/01/dead-notes-1-good-lovin-41771-dillon-gym-princeton/) [22]
